text: Ladies and gentlemen, from the house of Google, the precision counter-striker, the range-control kickboxer, the Paperwork Phantom! This fighter made weight with a far more natural face, the eyeliner wiped off and the chest emblem gone. But the realism score slid from forty-five down to twenty-six, because two claims on the paperwork were false. Fix those forms, champ, give that suit some real fabric, and the sky is the limit. In the charcoal-obsidian rashguard, standing one point seven three meters tall, GEMINI!
